purpose: Human-readable reference transcription for later parsing; not executable game logic.
scope: All rule images currently in reference: the two pages of the English player aid. This is not a full rulebook transcription.

questOfTheRing.timing: Immediate; each reward is used once when gained.

effects.description: Take 1 coin from the reserve.
Take another turn after finishing the current turn.
Place 1 unit in any region.
Remove 1 enemy fortress from any region and return it to the opponent.
The Sauron player immediately wins the game.
The Fellowship player immediately wins the game.

notes: This aid lists effect meanings, not their track positions or trigger thresholds.

effects.description: When you play a yellow card, take another turn after finishing the current turn.
When you play a red card, you may place all its units in any one of the seven regions.
Once per turn, benefit from any one skill.
When you play a landmark tile, ignore the additional coin cost.
When you play a landmark tile, take another turn after finishing the current turn.
When you play a green card, also complete 2 movements on the central board.
The Eagle is an additional race symbol, counting as one of the six required for the Support of the Races victory.
When you play a blue card, also place 1 unit in any region.
When you play a card using a chaining symbol, take 3 coins from the reserve.
When you play a yellow card, also move your character 1 space on the Quest of the Ring track.
When you play a red card, place 1 additional unit in the chosen region.
When you discard a card, take twice the coins associated with the current chapter from the reserve: 2, 4, or 6 coins.
Take another turn after finishing the current turn.
Remove 1 enemy fortress from any region and return it to the opponent.
Choose 3 times between removing 1 enemy unit, making the opponent lose 1 coin, or completing 1 movement on the central board.
Move your character 2 spaces on the Quest of the Ring track.
Place 2 units in one region of your choice, or 1 unit in each of two regions of your choice.
Take all discarded cards, secretly choose 1, and play it for free.
